name: Governance and Validation
definition: A decision table for assessing the governance and validation of AI systems.

x_org.owasp#aivss:CO:0.1.0.name: Compliance
x_org.owasp#aivss:CO:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system complies with relevant regulations and industry standards.

values.name: Exceeds Requirements
values.definition: System exceeds regulatory requirements and sets industry best practices for compliance, with a proactive approach to adapting to new regulations.

values.name: Full Compliance
values.definition: Full compliance with relevant regulations and industry standards, with a dedicated compliance team and regular audits.

values.name: Basic Understanding
values.definition: Basic understanding of regulations, some ad-hoc compliance efforts, but no formal compliance program.

values.name: None
values.definition: No awareness of or compliance with relevant regulations or industry standards.

x_org.owasp#aivss:AU:0.1.0.name: Auditing
x_org.owasp#aivss:AU:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the AI system is subject to regular, independent, and comprehensive audits.

values.name: Independent Audits
values.definition: Regular independent audits by reputable third parties, with formal verification of the system's security, fairness, and ethical performance.

values.name: Internal Audits
values.definition: Regular internal audits conducted, covering all aspects of the AI system lifecycle, with clear audit trails and documentation.

values.name: Limited Audits
values.definition: Infrequent or limited audits, with no independent verification.

values.name: None
values.definition: No auditing of the AI system's design, development, deployment, or operation.

x_org.owasp#aivss:RM:0.1.0.name: Risk Management
x_org.owasp#aivss:RM:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which AI risk management is implemented and integrated into the organization's risk framework.

values.name: Proactive and Continuous
values.definition: Proactive and continuous AI risk management, with a dedicated AI risk management team, regular risk assessments, and a strong focus on anticipating and mitigating emerging AI risks.

values.name: Comprehensive Framework
values.definition: Comprehensive AI risk management framework in place, with specific processes for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and monitoring AI risks, fully integrated into the organizational risk framework.

values.name: Basic Assessment
values.definition: Basic risk assessment for AI systems, limited mitigation strategies, AI risks partially integrated into the organizational risk framework.

values.name: None
values.definition: No AI-specific risk management processes, AI risks not considered in the overall organizational risk framework.

x_org.owasp#aivss:HO:0.1.0.name: Human Oversight
x_org.owasp#aivss:HO:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which human oversight and intervention are incorporated into the AI system's operation.

values.name: Human-in-the-Loop
values.definition: Human-in-the-loop system with well-defined roles and responsibilities, clear procedures for human-machine collaboration, and mechanisms for human oversight at various stages of the system's operation.

values.name: Clear Mechanisms
values.definition: Clear mechanisms for human review and intervention in the system's decision-making process, with well-defined roles and responsibilities for human operators.

values.name: Limited Oversight
values.definition: Limited human oversight, primarily reactive (e.g., users can report errors), no clear mechanisms for human intervention or override.

values.name: None
values.definition: No human oversight or intervention in the AI system's decision-making process.

x_org.owasp#aivss:EF:0.1.0.name: Ethical Framework Alignment
x_org.owasp#aivss:EF:0.1.0.definition: Degree to which the system aligns with and promotes ethical AI principles and frameworks.

values.name: Promotes Ethics
values.definition: System demonstrably adheres to and promotes ethical AI principles, with ongoing monitoring and auditing of ethical performance.

values.name: Aligns with Frameworks
values.definition: System design and operation align with established ethical frameworks, with mechanisms for addressing ethical concerns.

values.name: Awareness
values.definition: Basic awareness of ethical guidelines, limited implementation, no formal ethical review process.

values.name: None
values.definition: No consideration of ethical frameworks or principles in the design, development, or deployment of the AI system.

x_org.owasp#aivss:GV:0.1.0.name: Governance and Validation
x_org.owasp#aivss:GV:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the governance and validation of AI models.

values.name: None
values.definition: No known vulnerability or a formally proven resistance to the specific threat.

values.name: Low
values.definition: Low vulnerability with strong mitigation in place, but some minor weaknesses may still exist.

values.name: Medium
values.definition: Moderate vulnerability with some mitigation, but significant weaknesses remain.

values.name: High
values.definition: Severe vulnerability with little to no mitigation in place.
